tools.prompt: Create a 16-second cinematic night street-racing scene featuring Mara and Jace on an empty industrial boulevard, widescreen 16:9. Photorealistic, hard streetlight reflections, gritty asphalt and shuttered warehouses, tense and defiant. Five coherent shots with natural cuts, consistent drivers, modified cars and boulevard throughout. 0–3 seconds: medium-wide two-car starting-line view, a starter in a white jacket counts down between Mara’s modified red coupe and Jace’s modified silver hatchback, warehouse shutters behind him, slow push-in. 3–6 seconds: low wide view, the red coupe and silver hatchback launch together from the painted starting line, streetlights gleaming on pavement, fast lateral tracking. 6–10 seconds: close two-driver composition through open side windows, Jace in the silver hatchback and Mara in the red coupe shout one short challenge each toward the other during their neck-and-neck race, dark warehouse walls behind them, parallel tracking move. 10–13 seconds: low three-quarter wide view, Mara’s red coupe crosses the painted finish stripe first by half a hood ahead of Jace’s silver hatchback, industrial lamps overhead, sweeping lateral slide. 13–16 seconds: elevated wide establishing view of the empty finish stripe and shuttered warehouses alone, gentle ease-back into a final still composition. Sound: impatient engine rumble builds into roaring acceleration, launch tire shriek, rushing air; voices cut clearly through the engines. 0–3 seconds, starter says "three, two, one, go"; 6–8 seconds, Jace shouts "Keep up!"; 8–10 seconds, Mara shouts "Not tonight!" Hold the empty finish-line image still for the final two seconds. Cool cinematic shadows, vivid red highlights, urgent pacing. No voiceover, subtitles, text overlays or extra traffic.

story.place: An empty industrial boulevard lined with shuttered warehouses
story.prose: At night on an empty industrial boulevard, Mara grips the wheel of a modified red coupe beside Jace in a modified silver hatchback. Between their cars, a starter in a white jacket raises one hand. Streetlights gleam across the pavement as the engines climb into a rough, impatient roar. The starter counts down, “three, two, one, go,” drops his hand, and steps back as both cars launch from the line. Tires shriek; the coupe briefly loses traction while the hatchback surges ahead. Through his open window, Jace shouts toward Mara, “Keep up!” Mara steadies the red car, pulls alongside him, and shouts back, “Not tonight!” Their voices cut through the engines as the cars charge between the dark warehouses, nearly level. With the finish stripe approaching, Mara edges ahead by half a hood. The tense, defiant sprint ends as her red coupe crosses the finish first.
